How it works A multi-layer detection pipeline, built for accuracy at speed Pixel examines every file from several independent angles and combines the results into one verdict, so no single check decides alone. Its models are proprietary, developed in-house on the latest advances in media forensics research, and updated as the field moves, with no change to your integration. Verdict in seconds, with a record a reviewer can retrieve. 1. Ingest Files are submitted via the API or the web portal your team already uses. 2. Analyze A multi-step detection pipeline evaluates each file for manipulation and synthesis. 3. Score Signals combine into a confidence score with plain-language explanations attached. Frequently asked questions How is Pixel different from an AI detector? An AI detector answers one question: does this image look AI-generated? Much fraud looks different: an edited amount on a receipt, damage added to a real photo, an image that's already online. Pixel checks for all of it across images, video and documents, and shows the evidence behind every result, with a record of every check. Is Pixel independent of the companies that make AI tools? Yes. Pixel Systems doesn't build AI generators, so we have no stake in whether a file turns out to be AI-made. Pixel runs on our own proprietary models, kept current with the latest media forensics research. Does Pixel make the decision for us? No. Pixel shows whether a file has been generated, edited or manipulated, and the evidence behind that result. What that means for a claim, refund or case depends on context and business rules, so the decision stays with the organization. It sets which files clear automatically and which go to a reviewer. Built for enterprise workflows, not social media Generic deepfake detectors were built for social media, not for insurance claims, legal evidence review, or financial audit. Pixel is verification infrastructure for the workflows where a wrong call costs real money. Book a demo Explore solutions © 2026 Pixel Systems. All rights reserved. How we handle data Frequently asked questions How do I get API credentials? Contact sales for access to Pixel. Once your organization is onboarded, create an application in the dashboard and generate an API key. Every call to the API authenticates with that key. Which client should I use? Call the REST API from your backend in any language, or generate a typed client from the OpenAPI spec at api.pixelsystems.com/openapi.json. TypeScript SDKs are available on request. What file formats are supported? JPEG, PNG, HEIC/HEIF and PDF. That covers photos, scans and digital documents such as receipts, invoices and contracts. Video verification is on the roadmap. Can Pixel check every document in our virtual data room? Yes. Pixel connects to the virtual data rooms used in due diligence and audit, so every document is checked as it is uploaded, or in one pass over an existing room. The connection is set up as part of your integration; tell us which data room provider you use. How long does processing take? Most files complete in seconds, and the verdict comes back in the same request. Longer jobs can be fetched once they finish. How do I route a result to a reviewer? The verdict says so. An inconclusive assessment or a low confidence level is an answer you can route on: send those files to a reviewer instead of deciding automatically. Every verdict carries the per-dimension breakdown that reviewer needs. Ready to integrate? The docs carry the full reference: endpoints, error codes, rate limits, and the response shape.
